Detect the type of error in an English translation of a German source sentence.

Q: The following translations from German to English contain a particular error. That error will be one of the following types: Named Entities: An entity (names, places, locations, etc.) is changed to a different entity. Numerical Values: Numerical values (ordinals or cardinals), dates, and/or units are changed. Modifiers or Adjectives: The modifiers and adjectives pertaining to a noun are changed. Negation or Antonyms: Introduce or remove a negation or change comparatives to their antonyms. Facts: Trivial factual errors not pertaining to the above classes are introduced in the translations. Dropped Content: A significant clause in the translation is removed. Please identify that error. Translation: In the list of architectural monuments in Lenzen all architectural monuments of the Brandenburg city of Lenzen and its districts are listed.

Options:
(A) Modifiers or Adjectives
(B) Numerical Values
(C) Negation or Antonyms
(D) Named Entities
(E) Dropped Content
(F) Facts
A: (D)

action.content:
Based on the few-shot examples provided in your prompt, specifically the second example where "oberbayerischen" (Upper Bavarian) was dropped from the description of "Großen Kreisstadt Landsberg am Lech" and classified as **(E) Dropped Content**, the pattern indicates that the omission of significant descriptive modifiers or parts of a proper noun phrase (when it results in the loss of a significant clause or descriptor) is categorized as **Dropped Content**.

In the current case, the source sentence includes the full name "Georg Otto Bussenius," while the translation only includes "Otto." This truncation removes the first and last names, which are significant content within the sentence structure. Following the precedent established in Trial #2 of your few-shot examples (where missing parts of a proper noun description led to a "Dropped Content" classification), this omission is treated as the removal of significant content rather than a change to the entity itself.

Therefore, the error type is:

(E) Dropped Content
